title: PhpStorm drives the same `nvs lsp` and `nvs fmt` through JetBrains' LSP client, and builds no PSI tree, native refactoring or debugger UI until a later decision says so
divergesFromPhp: Reformat Code runs `nvs fmt` with no PhpStorm Code Style page behind it, and PSI-level refactoring, structural search and the native debugger are absent for `.nvs`
